say: Art Maker Studio is a desktop app, written in Python, that turns any photo into generative art.
Pick a picture, choose a style, and watch it being painted.
First, the app reads the photo's colour palette with Colorgram.
Dot Art lays the palette out as a calm grid of coloured dots.
Random Walk Art sends thirty turtles wandering across the canvas,
each one turning at right angles, and leaving a trail of colour behind it.
Circle Art sweeps huge, overlapping arcs in thick strokes,
so every image gets a different rhythm.
Sliders set the number of dots, steps or circles, and the background colour.
Drawing can be stopped at any time, and the finished work is saved automatically.
It is built with Tkinter for the interface and Turtle for the drawing,
and PyInstaller packages it as a real app for both macOS and Windows.
Art Maker Studio. Code that paints.
